# AAPL 2024Q3: freshly recomputed growth under v3

Latest local assessment cutoff 2024-08-02T23:59:59+00:00; reconstructed with a later-authored local method, not a contemporaneous forecast. Retained original accession 0000320193-24-000081, period 2024-03-31 through 2024-06-29; economic publication 2024-08-02 is eligible at cutoff. No retrieval or method date establishes historical economic availability.

Revenue 85777000000 versus 81797000000 USD gives 4.865704121178% year-over-year growth. Gross profit 39678000000 versus 36413000000 USD gives current margin 46.257155181459%, prior margin 44.516302553883%, change 1.740852627576 percentage points. Calculations use dollar inputs afresh, never saved percentage outputs. See calculations.json for formulas, exact Decimal results, alternative arithmetic checks and product reconciliation. Quarter values are compared with prior-year quarter values; cumulative columns, EPS and average shares are not subtracted.

Revenue expansion coexists with uneven demand: Services +3,000 and iPad +1,371 million offset iPhone -373 and Wearables/Home/Accessories -187; Mac +169 reconciles total +3,980. Greater China fell 1,030 million. Higher consolidated margin does not prove broad volume growth or durable pricing power; mix, pricing, currency, cost and launch timing cannot be separately quantified from this pack.

Source binding: `investing/assets/equities/aapl/data/2024Q3.json`, SHA256 `73c449ed301b494d1e217c21f2572fe80321d968d20388917292bc1cd95f6d27`, metadata `data/sources/2024Q3.json`. [Original filing reference](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000081/aapl-20240629.htm). The raw_ref is a retained transformed quarter pack, not HTML. Locally read period/identity metadata, four primary numeric inputs and MD&A product/geographic table_rows. Q2 original page was accessed for selected cover, fiscal labels, statement and MD&A passages documented in source-check.json; Q3 original was not newly opened and its identity was not re-researched. Original-page access does not retain raw HTML or verify the prior HTML hash. No full filing reading, raw-context validation, amendment inventory or fresh official filing-date check is claimed.

Method v3-authorship-corrected content and dependency were reverified; actual revision 2026-11-16T02:08:46.931664+00:00, content SHA256 c6d790cca884a1b91e02aecb267a09fcdde953921deae0b7cd6c98eeb15d3d36. Earlier v1/v2 exact author times were incorrectly supplied preparer declarations, not verified actual times; v2 was future when discovered. Old reports and frozen erroneous records remain intact. This new calculation/check/output supersedes affected growth, rather than rebinding old prose to v3. Q3 independent identity remains the exact predecessor unit.

Competing interpretation tested: margin improvement alone might look healthy despite concentrated revenue offsets; the category reconciliation and geographic weakness reject an unqualified broad-growth thesis. Source corrections, revised period definitions or quantified temporary mix/currency/cost effects could overturn the bounded interpretation. This completes only the configured growth question at retained-evidence scope. Full investment-case remains required and pending: full narrative, notes, governance, competition, forecasts, dated price and valuation are not resolved. No later-authored economic observations or later comparative rows from forecast/valuation supplements were used. No price, target, rating or expected return is invented.
